accepted_adr.content:
# ADR-018: Reduce payment retries after duplicate-charge review

Status: Accepted
Date: 2026-10-01
Supersedes: docs/ADR-017.md

## Decision

Payment processing must retry a failed charge at most two times. Reuse the same idempotency token. This accepted replacement follows a duplicate-charge risk review; deployed adapters require an explicit migration and must not be silently rewritten by documentation refresh.
